terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -o ezbookkeeping ezbookkeeping.go && if [ -f .env ]; then exec ./scripts/with-env.sh ./ezbookkeeping server run; else exec ./ezbookkeeping server run; fi
terminals.description: ezBookkeeping Go API server on http://localhost:8080. Rebuilds from current source, then runs it. Defaults to SQLite; if a .env file exists it is injected via scripts/with-env.sh (Supabase/PostgreSQL path).

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server (HMR) for the Vue 3 SPA on http://localhost:8081. Proxies /api, /mcp, /oauth2, /avatar, /pictures, /icons, /qrcode, /proxy, /_AMapService and */server_settings.js to the backend on :8080. Always work against :8081.
